output.summary: A perennial shrub reported as native across most circum-Mediterranean countries, although whether it is indigenous there is uncertain. It has rounded, fleshy leaves and large white to pinkish-white flowers with long violet stamens. Its flower buds and fruits are usually eaten salted or pickled as capers and caper berries.
